title: The Ball We Left Behind
idea: Childhood sweethearts Jun and Emi, separated by oceans for twelve years, quietly reunite in their foggy coastal hometown on an October eve. To bless their beloved crimson-clad port club before tomorrow’s pivotal championship match, they orchestrate a gentle midnight heist: infiltrating the cavernous seaside arena to swap the official match ball with a sentimental childhood talisman. If caught, Jun loses his cherished groundskeeper post. Yet standing beneath glowing floodlights, Emi confesses the heist was never about victory—it was merely an excuse to spend one last night with him.
visual: A quiet, mist-draped waterfront stadium beneath towering floodlights, where two solitary figures in woolen coats stand beside a single ball on vast green grass. The mood is poignantly serene and warmly nostalgic, painted in soft coastal blues, muted crimson, and hazy amber glows.
